display.purpose: Oversized section declarations in uppercase Archivo Black.

body.purpose: Practical descriptions and explanatory copy in Manrope.

components.name: Primary Order Button
components.description: The default high-priority order action on tomato or cream fields.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--mustard, oklch(0.82 0.16 84)); padding:0 28px; color:var(--ink, oklch(0.17 0.035 44)); font:900 15px Manrope, sans-serif; transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:var(--cream, oklch(0.965 0.025 86)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--mustard, oklch(0.82 0.16 84)); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Dark Order Button
components.description: The inverse call to action used on mustard fields.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--ink, oklch(0.17 0.035 44)); padding:0 28px; color:var(--cream, oklch(0.965 0.025 86)); font:900 15px Manrope, sans-serif; transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:var(--cream, oklch(0.965 0.025 86)); color:var(--ink, oklch(0.17 0.035 44)); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--tomato, oklch(0.54 0.225 29)); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-btn-dark:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Brand Wordmark
components.description: The stacked typographic brand mark used in the header and footer.
components.css: .ds-brand { display:inline-block; color:var(--cream, oklch(0.965 0.025 86)); font:900 22px/.8 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.035em; text-decoration:none; } .ds-brand span { display:block; color:var(--mustard, oklch(0.82 0.16 84)); } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--mustard, oklch(0.82 0.16 84)); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: Compact utility navigation centered over the hero image.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; color:var(--cream, oklch(0.965 0.025 86)); font:700 14px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--mustard, oklch(0.82 0.16 84)); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--mustard, oklch(0.82 0.16 84)); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Menu Row
components.description: A ruled, flat menu entry with price and circular order affordance.
components.html:
Doble Brava

Doble smash, cheddar, pepinillos, cebolla, lechuga y salsa Brava.

$29.900
components.css: .ds-menu-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:28px; align-items:center; min-height:220px; border-top:2px solid var(--ink, oklch(0.17 0.035 44)); border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink, oklch(0.17 0.035 44)); background:var(--cream, oklch(0.965 0.025 86)); color:var(--ink, oklch(0.17 0.035 44)); padding:0 8px; transition:background-color 180ms ease,transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-menu-row h3 { margin:0; font:400 clamp(34px,4vw,62px)/1 'Archivo Black',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-menu-row p { max-width:58ch; margin:12px 0 0; font:600 15px/1.5 Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-menu-order { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; font:800 18px Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-menu-order a { display:grid; width:58px; height:58px; place-items:center; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ink, oklch(0.17 0.035 44)); color:var(--cream, oklch(0.965 0.025 86)); transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-menu-row:hover { background:oklch(0.92 0.075 84); transform:translateX(8px); } .ds-menu-order a:hover { transform:rotate(8deg); background:var(--tomato, oklch(0.54 0.225 29)); } .ds-menu-order a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--tomato, oklch(0.54 0.225 29)); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-menu-order a:active { transform:scale(.95); }

components.name: Flame Mark
components.description: A circular mustard stamp that punctuates the manifesto.
components.css: .ds-flame-mark { display:grid; width:86px; height:86px; place-items:center; border:2px solid var(--mustard, oklch(0.82 0.16 84)); border-radius:50%; background:var(--tomato, oklch(0.54 0.225 29)); color:var(--mustard, oklch(0.82 0.16 84)); }

narrative.overview:
Brasa Brava feels like a neighborhood burger counter translated into crisp digital fields. Tomato red, deli-paper cream, mustard yellow, and near-black ink behave like sign paint: broad, blunt, and highly legible. Product photography is the only source of physical texture; the interface itself remains typographic, flat, and direct.

The system is appetite-first and deliberately loud without becoming busy. Oversized condensed-looking display forms carry the attitude, while compact Manrope copy keeps menu details practical. Density loosens around declarations and tightens around ordering decisions. The visual world supports the product promise: show the food immediately, name the choice concretely, and never manufacture social proof or operational certainty.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, full-bleed color fields with near-black divider lines.
Oversized Archivo Black declarations with very tight leading and tracking.
Mustard pill actions and circular near-black utility controls.
Food photography as the sole textured material.
Direct Spanish copy with no decorative claims or filler UI.

rules.name: The Four-Pot Rule
rules.body: Build the interface from tomato, mustard, cream, and ink; the hover wash is a state, not a fifth brand color.

rules.name: The Texture Belongs to Food Rule
rules.body: Keep UI surfaces flat and clean. Texture comes from burger photography, never from decorative grain, gradients, or faux paper effects.

rules.name: The Painted Declaration Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo Black for short declarations, never for explanatory paragraphs.

rules.name: The Tight-at-Scale Rule
rules.body: Large type earns its force from compact line-height and negative tracking; do not loosen it into generic marketing typography.

rules.name: The Appetite-First Viewport Rule
rules.body: The first screen belongs to one life-size burger, one product name, and one mustard action. Supporting explanation stays subordinate.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add card shadows, ambient glows, or floating panels. Use color adjacency, rules, and scale to establish hierarchy.

rules.name: The Ends-or-Edges Rule
rules.body: A shape is either square and architectural or fully rounded and actionable. Avoid intermediate card radii.

dos: Do let one appetite image dominate the first viewport.
Do use full-bleed tomato, mustard, cream, or ink fields to separate major sections.
Do reserve Archivo Black for short, high-impact declarations and Manrope for useful detail.
Do use hard rules and color changes instead of card chrome or shadows.
Do preserve the 760px single-column collapse and 22px mobile gutter.
Do pair every motion response with a reduced-motion-safe result.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, decorative texture, glass effects, or shadowed cards.
Don't add intermediate corner radii; use square fields, pill actions, or circles.
Don't expand hero display text beyond 6rem or let copy compete with the burger.
Don't dilute the palette with extra accents or use the hover wash as a resting surface.
Don't add feature-card grids, badges, testimonials, statistics, or unverified operational claims.
